name: Prir
source: Who is she? Where are her parents? What is she seeking? A mysterious girl that keeps the mighty sword in her body, has become part of dangerous adventure along with Caro and five "Flowers". She knows something that others do not know. She carries an excessive burden on her shoulders. But friends will never leave her in trouble, so she could feel herself an ordinary child and enjoy life.
